text: Adversarial iteration completed: removed simulate_fmri_matrix and its omitted task mean; data now come directly from the fitted seed+baseline+AR(1) model. Added an independent null-probe coefficient family, fitted-rho reporting, and explicit separation of single-run FDP from FDR calibration. Vignette runs 100 independent mixed/null fixtures: mean FDP 0.053 (one-sided upper 0.065), sensitivity 1.000 (lower 1.000), background FPR 0.015 (upper 0.018), complete-null rejection rate 0.070 (exact one-sided upper 0.127), mean fitted rho 0.249 for truth 0.3. Focused test raises to 200 fixtures: mean FDP 0.05406 (upper 0.06224), complete-null rate 0.065 (exact upper 0.10136), sensitivity 1.0, background FPR 0.01471 (upper 0.01715), fitted rho 0.25923; test runtime ~22s and warning capture is clean.
